author: Canu123
quote: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a true work of art. I only need to hear the first few notes of the title theme and I’m back in Hyrule. For me, it’s the greatest game of all time. Always has been, always will be.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Canu123
quote: My concern with GTA 6 is how easily violence becomes part of the fun. There’s already enough anger and hatred in everyday life, and I don’t see much appeal in a game that invites me to cause chaos just to see what happens. Games can explore violence in ways that make us think. What puts me off is when someone else’s suffering becomes the punchline. I’d rather see a game with this much ambition give us something more interesting to do with that freedom.
